text:
Elena: quick gut-check  thresholds row + preview area. Two decisions we keep circling: inline unit control (dropdown) vs micro-toggle (short/verbose), and how to handle pills at narrow widths (they're overlapping the rule title atm). Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/preview-stack-overlap.png

Tor: micro-toggle wins for density but only if SRs get the verbose form. Suggest visual `5m` + `aria-describedby='threshold-unit-desc'` where the desc reads `per 5 minutes`. That keeps rows compact and accessible.

Sam: Agree on keeping `5m` visually. Also copy nit: current helper `when error rate > 2%` is ambiguous. Change to `when error rate exceeds 2% (p95, over 5 minutes)` or let the percentile be a separate tag.

Caleb: Mobile: stop horizontal scroll for pills. Pattern: show first row + a "+N more" affordance that expands a stacked list. Use aria-expanded on the button and aria-controls to link the list. Expanded state should be a simple list with role=list and clear headings.

a11y-bot: Contrast: muted pill color #6a6a6a on #fff = 3.95. Fails AA for 14px. Recommendation: neutral-700 (#333333) or semibold 600 at 14px. Also require focus-visible (2px solid token-focus) on pills and an aria-live polite region when suppression state changes: `Suppression enabled  2 channels muted`.

Elena: edge case: routing fallbacks currently hidden in preview. We should surface them as `Primary: Slack (latency)   Fallback: Email (on error)` with a tooltip `why this fallback?` that explains trigger conditions. Helps on-call teams.

Tor: implementation detail: keep muted pills in DOM (dimmed + `aria-label='PagerDuty  muted'`) instead of removing them. Screen readers need to know state. The +N button should announce `Show 3 more channels` and change to `Hide channels` when expanded.

Sam: microcopy proposal for helper: `When error rate exceeds 2% (p95, over 5 minutes). Learn more.` Link goes to docs explaining p95 vs p99. For preview header: `Previewing 3 channels  1 muted`.

Caleb: telemetry ask: capture expand/collapse of the +N list and instances where users toggle unit control between short/verbose so we can see confusion hotspots.

Elena-bot: Added Figma comments: https://figma.redwood.in/frame/alerting-thresholds-iter. Action items: Tor mock micro-toggle + sr-only desc, Sam update helper copy & percentile tooltip, Caleb prototype mobile stacked preview + aria attributes, Elena pick accessible color token and update pill states. Target: next design sync Tuesday morning.

Tor: I'll post both dropdown and toggle mocks by Monday EOD.

Sam: I'll drop copy updates in Figma and link the docs.

Caleb: I'll upload a mobile prototype and telemetry notes.

Elena: thanks team :thumbsup:
